minutes.headline: Committee heard TCPaso is too decayed for interim use, backed Brooks House sale exploration, and settled RFP bidder answers.
minutes.summary: The facility manager reported the TC Pasos building has failing roof, heating, electrical and water systems, and the $300,000 roof money is on hold. Members were generally supportive of the APDC request to explore selling the Brooks House. The committee settled responses to bidder questions on the design RFP and planned community updates ahead of a spring borrowing article.

public_comment.topic: Chair asked for public comment at the start; none offered.
Chair asked for public comment at the end and invited the remote caller to unmute; none heard.

votes.motion: Motion to adjourn, by roll call

budget_items.what_was_said: Capital plan money approved for the central roof section has been put on hold because that section may be torn down. Facility manager suggested redirecting it to portions that will be saved.
Control system runs on Windows XP; even limping it along would cost tens of thousands.
Abatement must be done regardless and costs rise each year, so starting now was suggested.

Earlier estimates for reuse ranged from a floor to a ceiling, with the estimate rising before town meeting; chair framed the policy question of spending that much without addressing Ritter or Town Hall.

budget_items.topic: TC Pasos operating loss and school rent
budget_items.what_was_said: Building runs at a net loss; a rent increase for the school was floated, though the school may leave instead.

budget_items.topic: RFP project cost range for qualifying experience
budget_items.what_was_said: A bidder asked to widen the range of prior project costs; the committee agreed to keep the existing range.
A member asked when fees get discussed; the chair said cost proposals are already requested separately and a RFP section borrowed from another project will be corrected.
APDC said no money is requested yet for the sale exploration; any funding would come to the May town meeting.

decisions.decision: Respond to bidders that buildings are public, floor plans of Town Hall and Ritter will be sent, and an optional site visit will be scheduled with the facility manager next Monday or Tuesday.
Provide bidders the name of the firm and dates of prior studies and floor plans extracted from them, but withhold the full studies until award.
Seven years is the correct look-back in the RFP; the five-year reference will be corrected.
Keep the 10 to 20 million project range unchanged.
No minority/women/veteran-owned business participation goals will be added.
Chair and procurement staff will amend the RFP to remove the erroneous fee-proposal section; exact language to be set the next day.
Consensus that the committee is generally supportive of the APDC request to explore selling the Brooks House; chair will report this feedback to the select board.
Chair to begin community updates to Finance Committee and other boards; presenters to be discussed at next meeting.
Next meeting set for November 4 at 5:30 pm; minutes to be listed on that agenda.

what_happened.line: The committee heard that the TC Pasos building has failing roof, heating, electrical and water systems, and that capital-plan roof money is on hold.
Members voiced general support for the APDC request to explore selling the Brooks House; the chair will pass that feedback to the select board.
The committee settled answers to bidder questions on the design RFP, including keeping the project cost range and correcting the look-back period.
The chair and procurement staff will amend the RFP to remove a fee-proposal section that was included in error.
The chair will begin community updates to the Finance Committee and other boards; the next meeting is November 4 at 5:30 pm.

why_it_matters: The roof money was approved in the capital plan and is now held because part of the building may be torn down, so a spending decision already made is being revisited.
The Brooks House sale exploration has no funding request yet; any money would come to the May town meeting, a vote residents may be asked to take.
The design RFP sets the scope for work the committee expects to bring to a spring borrowing article, so the bidder answers shape what that article may ask for.
watch_next: Next meeting November 4 at 5:30 pm: presenters for the community updates and the amended RFP language.
May town meeting: any funding article for exploring the Brooks House sale.
